description:
After years of training, Kim Ryeo-Dam finally made his idol debut. Though not the most popular member of his group, he had his own reason for staying: a quiet, persistent crush on his teammate, Cha Jin-Won. One night, alone at home, Ryeo-Dam stumbled upon a spicy fanfic featuring himself and Jin-Won. The story stirred something in him, and he slipped into the bathroom for a moment of release. But just as he emerged, flustered and breathless, he came face to face with Jin-Won, who had returned early and seen everything. Jin-Won didn’t get angry. Instead, he teased, his voice laced with curiosity and something unreadable. Ryeo-Dam’s mind raced to recover, but before he could stop himself, the words tumbled out.

 *“What if we tried it... for real?”*

Regret hit him the second the words left his mouth. But Jin-Won didn’t laugh or step back. He simply leaned in and pressed a soft kiss to Ryeo-Dam’s cheek. And what brushed against Ryeo-Dam’s thigh wasn’t just Jin-Won’s leg. He was hard.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three side story chapters.*
